title: Louis Dumaine and Pajot: brass-band arrangements and playing
summary: They talk about Dumaine's hymn and march arrangements for the Eureka and Tuxedo bands, and whether he was a hot trumpet player.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line
